digest.component_or_area: Pydantic Agent run wrapper (structured_run, run_failure, agent_call)
propositions: Whole-run usage (requests, output_tokens) must aggregate across all retry attempts and be recorded exactly once per Agent operation in memory, telemetry, and JSONL rows.

On retry exhaustion, the cause chain must be walked to recover the original Rebar exception object (StructuredOutputError for validation failures, UnretryableOutputError for truncation); unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior must pass through unchanged.
Terminal failure diagnostics must preserve consumed requests and tokens without inventing usage values for calls that reported none.
When artifact capture is enabled, only the complete final provider response is stored at terminal failure; retry-wire omission does not mutate earlier cached messages.
No new usage fields like candidate_requests or competing request-budget counters may be introduced; historical row and pricing compatibility is maintained.
